proposals.before: He was soon promoted to attendant in the Office of the Censorate.
proposals.after: He was soon promoted to supervising secretary (給事中).
proposals.reason: 給事中 is a Chancellery supervising secretary, not an office of the Censorate; the English misidentifies the institution.

proposals.before: He was gradually promoted to attendant in the Office of the Censorate.
proposals.after: He was gradually promoted to supervising secretary (給事中).
proposals.reason: Same institutional mistranslation of 給事中 as a Censorate post.

proposals.before: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Phoenix Terrace.
proposals.after: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Luan Terrace (鸞臺侍郎).
proposals.reason: 鸞臺 is the Wu-Zhou Chancellery name, distinct from 鳳閣; Phoenix Terrace conflates the two.

proposals.before: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Phoenix Terrace.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Luan Terrace (鸞臺侍郎).
proposals.reason: Same 鸞臺/Phoenix Terrace conflation in the literal rendering.

proposals.before: When Zhang Xi joined the government, Qiao—being of his faction—was dismissed to the post of Rector of the Imperial University.
proposals.after: When Zhang Xi joined the government, Qiao—being his sister's son—was dismissed to the post of Rector of the Imperial University.
proposals.reason: 其出也 means Qiao was Zhang Xi's sister's son (maternal nephew), not a factional ally.

proposals.before: When Zhang Xi entered the government, Qiao, being of the same faction, was removed and made Rector of the Imperial University.
proposals.after: When Zhang Xi entered the government, Qiao, being his sister's son, was removed and made Rector of the Imperial University.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 出 as faction instead of sister's son.

proposals.before: Now the common people are destitute and poor, without secure dwellings—they cannot keep the throne.
proposals.after: Now the common people are destitute and poor, without secure dwellings—one cannot keep the throne.
proposals.reason: Literal English wrongly makes the destitute people the ones who cannot keep the throne; the Chinese warns that the throne cannot be held while the people lack secure homes.

proposals.before: Soon he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Director of the Secretariat.
proposals.after: Soon he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Grand Councilor.
proposals.reason: 同中書門下平章事 denotes associate grand councilor / chancellor-equivalent rank, not a second Associate Director of the Secretariat.

proposals.before: His father Jing served as Long Secretary of Wei Prefecture and was known as a talented official.
proposals.after: His father Jing served as Chief Administrator of Wei Prefecture and was known as a talented official.
proposals.reason: 長史 means prefectural Chief Administrator; 'Long Secretary' invents a place-name from 長.

proposals.before: His father Jing was Long Secretary of Wei Prefecture and was called a talented official.
proposals.after: His father Jing was Chief Administrator of Wei Prefecture and was called a talented official.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 長史 as 'Long Secretary' instead of Chief Administrator.

proposals.before: I ask that from the chancellor and the sons of directors of all ministries onward, all be given outer offices, together bringing peace to the hundred surnames, inner and outer mutually coordinated.
proposals.after: I ask that the sons of the chancellor and of the directors of all ministries all be given outer offices, together bringing peace to the hundred surnames, inner and outer mutually coordinated.
proposals.reason: 宰相及諸司長官子弟 means sons of the chancellor and ministry directors, not 'from the chancellor and the sons… onward'.

proposals.before: He was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Ministry of State.
proposals.after: He was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
proposals.reason: 尚書右丞 is a vice-directorate in the Shangshu sheng (Department of State Affairs), not a 'Ministry of State'.

proposals.before: He was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Ministry of State.
proposals.after: He was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
proposals.reason: Same office error: 尚書右丞 belongs to the Department of State Affairs.

proposals.before: When Jiaozhi rebelled, Zangyong earned merit in defense; he was made Registrar in Zha Prefecture, promoted to Long Secretary of Qian Prefecture acting as military commissioner, and died at Shixing.
proposals.after: When Jiaozhi rebelled, Zangyong earned merit in defense; he was made Registrar in Zha Prefecture, promoted to Chief Administrator of Qian Prefecture acting as military commissioner, and died at Shixing.
proposals.reason: 長史 is changshi 'chief administrator', not 'Long Secretary'.

proposals.before: When Jiaozhi rebelled, Zangyong had merit in defense; he was changed to Registrar in Zha Prefecture, promoted to Long Secretary of Qian Prefecture and acting military commissioner, and died at Shixing.
proposals.after: When Jiaozhi rebelled, Zangyong had merit in defense; he was changed to Registrar in Zha Prefecture, promoted to Chief Administrator of Qian Prefecture and acting military commissioner, and died at Shixing.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 長史 as 'Long Secretary'.

proposals.before: Sima Chengzhen once summoned him to court; as he was about to return to the mountains, Zangyong pointed to Zhongnan and said, "There are many fine places here".
proposals.after: Sima Chengzhen was once summoned to court; as he was about to return to the mountains, Zangyong pointed to Zhongnan and said, "There are many fine places here".
proposals.reason: 司馬承禎嘗召至闕下 means Chengzhen was summoned to the palace, not that he summoned Zangyong.

proposals.before: Sima Chengzhen once summoned him to the palace; as he was about to return to the mountains, Zangyong pointed to Zhongnan and said: "Within this there are many fine places".
proposals.after: Sima Chengzhen was once summoned to the palace; as he was about to return to the mountains, Zangyong pointed to Zhongnan and said: "Within this there are many fine places".
proposals.reason: Literal English reverses the subject of 召至闕下.

proposals.before: Wei Juyuan was of the same lineage as Wei Anshi and great-great-grandson of Zong, Metropolitan Governor under the Later Zhou.
proposals.after: Wei Juyuan was of the same lineage as Wei Anshi and great-grandson of Zong, Metropolitan Governor under the Later Zhou.
proposals.reason: 曾孫 is great-grandson, not great-great-grandson.

proposals.before: Wei Juyuan was of the same lineage as Anshi and great-great-grandson of Zong, Metropolitan Governor of the Later Zhou.
proposals.after: Wei Juyuan was of the same lineage as Anshi and great-grandson of Zong, Metropolitan Governor of the Later Zhou.
proposals.reason: Same kinship-degree error for 曾孫.

proposals.before: Yanzhao asked where the plan came from; Lüwen then asked Princess Anle to keep him, and General Yang Ju was substituted.
proposals.after: Yanzhao asked what plan there was; Lüwen then asked Princess Anle to keep him, and General Yang Ju was substituted.
proposals.reason: Chinese 問計安出 asks what stratagem to adopt, not the provenance of a plan.

proposals.before: He once wore women's dress and rode in a carriage with his wife to call together—the shaman's power gained him the chancellorship.
proposals.after: He once wore women's dress and rode in a carriage with his wife to pay a visit together—the shaman's power gained him the chancellorship.
proposals.reason: Chinese 偕謁 means to pay a visit together; 'call together' loses that sense.

proposals.before: He Fengyao was a native of Qi in Qi Prefecture.
proposals.after: He Fengyao was a native of Qishan in Qi Prefecture.
proposals.reason: Chinese 岐山 is the place-name Qishan, not bare 'Qi'.

proposals.before: He Fengyao was a man of Qi in Qi Prefecture.
proposals.after: He Fengyao was a man of Qishan in Qi Prefecture.
proposals.reason: Chinese 岐山 is Qishan; 'Qi' duplicates the prefecture and loses the place.

proposals.before: Fengyao, because the mission had purpose, was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
proposals.after: Fengyao, because the mission achieved its aim, was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
proposals.reason: Chinese 以使有指 means the mission met its intended aim.

decisions.after: He was soon promoted to supervising secretary.
decisions.reason: 稍遷給事中 names the Menxia supervising secretary, not a Censorate office; the proposal is right but the English field must not embed 給事中.

decisions.after: He was gradually promoted to supervising secretary.
decisions.reason: The same 給事中 is not a Censorate post; keep ‘supervising secretary’ without the Chinese gloss in the literal English.

decisions.after: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Luan Terrace.
decisions.reason: 遷鸞臺侍郎 is the Wu-Zhou Menxia vice-directorship, distinct from 鳳閣/Phoenix; drop the parenthetical 鸞臺侍郎 from the English replacement.

decisions.after: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Luan Terrace.
decisions.reason: Literal likewise mislabels 鸞臺 as Phoenix Terrace; use Luan Terrace alone without Chinese characters in the English field.
嶠，其出也 uses kinship 出 for sister’s son (maternal nephew of Zhang Xi), not factional membership.
The same 其出也 requires ‘sister’s son’ in the literal; ‘same faction’ invents a political bond the Chinese does not state.
Following 何以守位曰仁, 不可以守位 is impersonal: the throne cannot be kept amid 百姓乏窶, not that the people themselves cannot keep it.
同中書門下平章事 is associate grand councilor rank, not a second Secretariat directorship; the idiomatic already has the correct title.
魏州長史 is prefectural chief administrator (changshi); ‘Long Secretary’ misreads 長 as a place-name element.
The same 長史 error in the literal; Chief Administrator restores the office title.
宰相及諸司長官子弟 means the sons of the chancellor and of ministry directors; ‘from the chancellor and the sons… onward’ misparses the modifier 子弟.
尚書右丞 is Right Vice Director in the Shangshu sheng (Department of State Affairs), not a ‘Ministry of State’.
Literal repeats the same institutional mislabel for 尚書右丞; Department of State Affairs is correct.
遷黔州長史 again uses changshi ‘chief administrator’; ‘Long Secretary’ is the same mistranslation as in s0153.
Literal 黔州長史 requires Chief Administrator, not Long Secretary.
司馬承禎嘗召至闕下 makes Chengzhen the one summoned to court; the original reverses agent and patient.
The same 召至闕下 is passive of Chengzhen’s summons; ‘was once summoned’ corrects the reversed subject.
總曾孫 is great-grandson (generation distance 3); great-great-grandson would be 玄孫.
Literal likewise overstates 曾孫 as great-great-grandson; great-grandson matches the kinship term.

decisions.after: Yanzhao asked what plan to adopt; Lüwen then asked Princess Anle to keep him, and General Yang Ju was substituted.
decisions.reason: 問計安出 asks what stratagem to put forth, not whence a plan came; the proposal’s sense is right, but ‘what plan there was’ is awkward—‘what plan to adopt’ is clearer.
與妻偕謁 means he and his wife paid a visit together (to the shaman of s0242); ‘call together’ loses the sense of 謁.
岐州岐山人 names Qishan county within Qi Prefecture; bare ‘Qi’ drops 岐山 and duplicates the prefecture.
The same 岐山 requires Qishan in the literal native-place formula.
以使有指 means the embassy achieved its intended aim (指), after Mochuo’s submission in s0261; ‘had purpose’ understates the success.
